changes.comment: Public MCP contract closeout (issue #199 Slice 1): teammate.spawn input is now name_prefix (returns the concrete name); team.create/status/history/dissolve/bind_group address by team_name. teammate.history and team.history return { items, next_cursor } and drop the legacy id/team_id/display_name/close_status/state filters, the machine-local source_cwd/runtime_cwd/worktree fields, the Dreamux-made session_id, and runtime checkpoint from public params and rows. The BREAKING/Rebuild upgrade note for this Epic lands in the final slice.
